fusions.name: Lingering Prick
fusions.desc: A slow prick that deals 3 damage and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 8 seconds, with a 20% chance to leave it [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Drifting Mine
fusions.desc: Sends a point drifting slowly forward that deals 26 damage to the first enemy it meets and 80% of that to every enemy within 3.5 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Calming Points
fusions.desc: Restores 14 health to you and every ally within 3.5 tiles, and more the faster you cast.

fusions.name: Slow Tide In
fusions.desc: When your health falls below 35%, you regain 4 health a second for 5 seconds. Once every 30 seconds.
